facts.text: Catch whoever empties Quinn's good ale stock at the Golden Egg each night and collect Quinn's 100 gold.

Quinn and Sir Phidipaldi have planned a fake ale delivery: Quinn brings bottles, they fill them with water, and Sir Phidipaldi makes a big show of delivering ale to the Golden Egg to see who comes for it.
